explainer_content.short_definition: 1980s metal turned into neon arena pop: riffs, hooks, hair, and spectacle.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Glam metal carried hard-rock and metal vocabulary into MTV-ready choruses, image theater, and enormous studio sound.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It defined a mainstream metal memory that still shapes karaoke, classic-rock radio, and power-ballad culture.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The difference is the gloss: hooks, visual identity, and chorus size are as important as riff weight.

Guns N' Roses anchors Glam Metal / Hair Metal / Pop Metal by making drum weight and speed and minor-mode tension easier to hear.
